messages:
maya: Quick sync: customers keep asking for per-route cost plus an easy error->trace jump. I want a minimalist plan we can ship in 3 weeks. Thoughts?

omar: Agree on minimal. propose 2-phase: Phase A (3w): cost summary card (7d/30d), top-10 tenants, CSV export, error table with a trace button that reads trace_id from metrics. Phase B (Q3): route-level token breakout, full explorer, 30d retention.

leah: Can we add a basic webhook alert for cost spikes in Phase A? customers called that out. webhook can be alpha.

dennis: Engineering notes: write trace_id into the metric envelope at emit time, UI surfaces link. Sampling default 0.5% global, per-tenant override for Dedicated. Estimates: trace plumbing 6 dev-days, UI + CSV 4 dev-days, webhook 2 dev-days, infra indexing 3 dev-days. total ~15 dev-days across squads.

maya: Launch gates proposal: 1) accuracy: cost card within 5% vs billing for top-20 tenants over 7d; 2) UX: trace button opens correct trace <=2s for sampled traces 95% of time; 3) perf: summary render p95 <700ms; 4) reliability: csv/webhook >=99% success in canary; 5) privacy signoff.

omar: Tests: billing replay to validate accuracy, e2e trace-button test, telemetry events cost_view/csv_download/trace_open/alert_fire. Add feature flag and kill-switch.

product-bot: Created ticket RD-54000: "console: obs-slim MVP (cost card + trace-link + CSV + webhook alpha)" assigned to @dennis, due 2026-05-08. :robot_face:

maya: Decision: ship Phase A as described. Action items: dennis to split RD-54000 into subtasks + estimates (EOD), leah to draft acceptance tests (Tue), omar to coordinate pilot customers (Mon), ops to prepare kill-switch and privacy intake. We'll demo in product sync next week. :thumbsup:
